label: Baseline (workbook data set)
note: The v10 workbook's 210-row synthetic set exactly. Utilisation just under the agreed threshold.

label: Healthy adoption
note: Idle seats activated, most users return weekly, verified hours reported, unit cost inside the threshold.

label: Overstated usage (vendor MAU high)
note: Everyone logs in, so the vendor MAU proxy looks great, but few people return. Unit cost per verified hour is high.

label: Shelfware (paid seats unused)
note: Six users stop using the assistant and purchased seats grow to 40; many paid and assigned seats have no qualifying use.

label: New-country launch cohort
note: A new country (Region D) launches with 8 seats and is still ramping; no verified study yet.

label: Reliability incident (connector outage)
note: Connector outage on the onboarding agent: most connector calls fail for two weeks.

label: Missing interaction IDs
note: The SDK release dropped interaction IDs, so every interaction is sessionised (approximate) and no study can attribute impact.

label: Critical-risk breach (privacy)
note: Card data found outside the masked zone in an agent log: the score turns red and renewal needs remediation.
